Short title and commencement

ACT XVII OF 1994
ACT XVII OF 1994
LIGHTHOUSE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
An Act further to amend the
Lighthouse Act 1927
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 13th October, 1994]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 8th
October, 1994 and is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Lighthouse (Amendment) Act, 1994.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment in section 10, Act XVII of 1927

2. Amendment in section 10, Act XVII of 1927.--In the Lighthouse
Act, 1927 (XVII of 1927), in section 10, in subsection (1),---
(a) after the
word and comma "may,", the words and comma "from time to
time," shall be inserted; and
(b) the commas
and words ", not exceeding fifty paisa per ton," shall be omitted.
